25001.meaning2: emblem or characteristic sign of a householder

25002.meaning1: layperson's duty; householder's responsibility; (comm) the five precepts

examples.text: katame pañca? bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, santo sappurisā bhajanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, gihidhammā anapagato hoti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dāne ānisaṃsā'ti.

25003.meaning1: not avoided the layperson's duty; not strayed from the householder's responsibility; (comm) with unbroken five precepts

examples.text: katame pañca? bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, santo sappurisā bhajanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, gihidhammam'anupagato hoti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dāne ānisaṃsā'ti.

25004.meaning1: rule about making laywomen give massages

25005.meaning2: kind or style of (under) garment worn by a householder

25006.meaning2: in the way a householder wears his (under) garments

25007.meaning2: wife of a householder; woman who lives the household (worldly and sensual) life
25007.construction:
√gah > geh > gih + a + inī
geha + inī

examples.text: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ek'upāsikā'pi sāvikā gihinī odātavasanā brahmacārinī yā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā'ti?

25008.meaning1: concerned with laypeople; connected with householders

examples.text: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva imesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ āpatti yā ca attano āpatti, imesañ'c'eva āyasmantānaṃ atthāya attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.

25009.meaning1: suitable for a householder; fit for a layperson

examples.text: idha ca mahīpatissa kāmabhogī, gihipatirūpakā bahū bhavanti, yadi ca jahati sabbakāmabhogaṃ, labhati anuttaraṃ uttamadhan'aggan'ti.

25011.meaning1: assembly of laypeople; congregation of householders

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.

25012.meaning2: kind or style of (under) garment worn by a householder

25013.meaning2: in the way a householder wears his (under) garments

examples.text: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.

25016.meaning1: state of being a householder; layperson

25017.meaning1: as a layperson; as a householder

examples.text: caturāsīti vassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi. caturāsīti vassasahassāni gihibhūto dhamme pāsāde brahmacariyaṃ cari.

25018.commentary: (SNa) gihibhogā ca parihīno'ti yo agāre vasantehi gihīhi dāyajje bhājiyamāne bhogo laddhabbo assa, tato ca parihīno. (ITIa) gāthāsu gihibhogā'ti kāmasukhasambhogato.

examples.text: tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca na paripūreti.
gihibhogā parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca dubbhago, paridhaṃsamāno pakireti, chav'ālātaṃ'va nassati.

25019.meaning2: distinctive marks or character of a householder

25020.meaning1: excessively involved in the instruction of laypeople
25020.commentary: (SNa) gihisaññattibahulo'ti rattiñ'ca divā ca bahukālaṃ gihī saññāpayanto.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando ativelaṃ gihisaññattibahulo viharati.

25021.meaning1: initiative of a householder; undertaken by a layperson
25021.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.9) gihisamārambho nāma ñātakā vā honti pavāritā vā pakatipaṭiyattaṃ vā. (VINa) gihīnaṃ samārambho gihisamārambho

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhuniparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā, pācittiyaṃ.

25022.meaning1: fetter to lay life; bond to being a householder

examples.text: atthi nu kho, bho gotama, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass'antakaro'ti? n'atthi kho, vaccha, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass'antakaro'ti.

25023.meaning1: association with householders; mingling with laypeople

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.

idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bālo hoti abyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehi, tañ'ce saṅgho nissāreti, sunissārito. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho nissāreti, sunissārito.

25024.meaning1: involved with laypeople; mixed up with (the affairs of) householders

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhu, manussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati, sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, manussaggāho.

25025.meaning1: correct course for a layperson; suitable way for a householder

examples.text: catūhi kho, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. katamehi catūhi?

25026.meaning1: suitable for householders; appropriate for laypeople

examples.text: yāni c'imāni, bhante, bhagavatā gihisāmīcikāni sikkhāpadāni desitāni, n'āhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani khaṇḍaṃ samanupassāmī'ti. lābhā te, gahapati, suladdhaṃ te, gahapati!

25027.meaning1: path of practice suitable for a layperson; way appropriate for a householder

examples.text: catūhi kho, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. katamehi catūhi?

25028.meaningLit: discourse on appropriate course for a layperson

examples.text: katamāni dve? gihisukhañ'ca pabbajitasukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

25032.commentary: (VINt) gihivikatan'ti gihīhi kataṃ paññattaṃ, gihisantakan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gihivikataṃ abhinisīdituṃ, natv'eva abhinipajjitunti.

25033.commentary: (VIN) gihiveyyāvaccaṃ nāma agārikassa yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā pacati, sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā dhovati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

25035.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

25037.meaning2: layman, who leads a domestic life
25037.construction:
√gah > geh > gih + a + ī
geha + ī

examples.text: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.
tesaṃ gihī pasann'ākāraṃ karonti. te taṃ lābhaṃ agadhitā amucchitā anajjhopannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.

25039.meaning2: state of a layman; being a householder

examples.text: caturāsīti vassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi. caturāsīti vassasahassāni gihībhūto dhamme pāsāde brahmacariyaṃ cari.
ruṇṇam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. ummattakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. komārakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ.

atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma. tattha hoti annam'pi pānam'pi khajjam'pi bhojjam'pi leyyam'pi peyyam'pi naccam'pi gītam'pi vāditam'pi. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dhovanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti

kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.

25048.meaning2: sound or tone of singing; singing accent or tone

examples.text: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ etadavoca, saṃsandati kho te, pañcasikha, tantissaro gītassarena, gītassaro ca tantissarena, na ca pana te pañcasikha, tantissaro gītassaraṃ ativattati, gītassaro ca tantissaraṃ.
saṅkho ca paṇavo ca saṅkhapaṇavaṃ, gītañ'ca vāditañ'ca gītavāditaṃ, daddari ca ḍiṇḍimo ca daddariḍiṇḍimaṃ. evaṃ tūriy'aṅg'atthe.

aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu kho kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyā'ti?
so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggahitvā, gīvāya suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya.
yassa passena migo palāyati, tass'eva gīvā'ti

25055.commentary: (VINa) sīs'ūpagan'ti-ādīsu sīsaṃ upagacchatī'ti sīs'ūpagaṃ, potthakesu pana sīs'ūpakan'ti likhitaṃ, yassa kassaci sīs'ālaṅ'kārass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.
yassa kassaci piḷandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati, yadi muddikāya yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi gīveyyakāya yadi suvaṇṇamālāya, tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhoti.
ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.
guṇavantānañ'hi guṇaṃ buddhā eva pākaṭaṃ kātuṃ sakkonti, avasesajano guṇavantānaṃ guṇaṃ kathento maccharāyati
yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.
ucc'āvacā hi paṭipadā, samaṇena pakāsitā, na pāraṃ diguṇaṃ yanti, na'y'idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutaṃ.
yadā pana te, soṇa, vīṇāya tantiyo na accāyatā honti n'ātisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.
atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi. tam'enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṅkhāditvā ajjhohari. tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi.

25069.commentary: (DNa) nāgo'va sannāni guṇānī'ti kāmasaññojanabandhanāni chetvā deve tāvatiṃse atikkamiṃsu.

examples.text: nāgo'va sannāni guṇāni chetvā, deve tāvatiṃse atikkamiṃsu, saindā devā sapajāpatikā, sabbe sudhammāya sabhāy'upaviṭṭhā.

25070.meaning2: stitching to strengthen the edge of a belt

examples.text: ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto'ti etthā'pi ayam'adhippāyo. ayaṃ bhante amhākaṃ bhagavato sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ ārabbha guṇakathā vippakatā, na rājakath'ādikā tiracchānakathā, atha bhagavā anuppatto, taṃ no idāni niṭṭhāpetvā desethā'ti.

25074.meaning2: like a sticky ball of thread

examples.text: gambhīro c'āyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīr'āvabhāso ca. etassa, ānanda, dhammassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'ayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā, guṇagaṇṭhikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

25078.meaning1: enumeration of qualities; expression of praise; eulogy

examples.text: padānī'ti ayaṃ evaṃ sīlavā ahosi, evaṃ dussīlo'ti-ādinā nayena pavattāni guṇapadāni. sarīram'eva vā ettha padānī'ti adhippetaṃ.

25079.meaning1: defaming the character; ridiculing the good qualities (of)

25080.meaning1: fact of being full of good qualities

25083.meaning2: possessed of good qualities or virtues

examples.text: guṇavanto'pi saṅghamhi, voharantā yath'ātthato, dubbalā te bhavissanti, hirīmanā anatthikā.
guṇavantānañ'hi guṇaṃ buddhā eva pākaṭaṃ kātuṃ sakkonti, avasesajano guṇavantānaṃ guṇaṃ kathento maccharāyati

25085.meaning1: devoid of virtues; without good qualities
25085.commentary: (THa) guṇahīnā'ti sīl'ādiguṇavirahitā dussīlā, alajjino ca. atha vā guṇahīnā'ti vinaya-vāritt'ādi-guṇena hīnā dhammavinaye appakataññuno.

examples.text: guṇahīnā'pi saṅghamhi, voharantā visāradā, balavanto bhavissanti, mukharā assutāvino.

25086.meaning1: virtues and defects; good and bad qualities
25086.commentary: (APAa) guṇ'āguṇavidū'ti guṇañ'ca aguṇañ'ca guṇ'āguṇaṃ, vaṇṇ'āvaṇṇaṃ, kusal'ākusalaṃ vā taṃ jānātī'ti guṇ'āguṇavidū.

examples.text: na mahapphalo'ti vipākaphalena na mahapphalo hoti. na mah'ānisaṃso'ti guṇ'ānisaṃsena mah'ānisaṃso na hoti. na mahājutiko'ti ānubhāvajutiyā mahājutiko na hoti.

25090.meaning1: with qualities; with virtues; with characteristics

examples.text: aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ, pajahiṃ paṇṇasālakaṃ, upāgamiṃ rukkhamūlaṃ, guṇe dasah'upāgataṃ.

taṇhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi jāliniṃ saritaṃ visaṭaṃ visattikaṃ, yāya ayaṃ loko uddhasto pariyonaddho tant'ākulakajāto gulāguṇṭhikajāto muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
sududdasaṃ sunipuṇaṃ, yatthakāmanipātinaṃ, cittaṃ rakkhetha medhāvī, cittaṃ guttaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.
annañ'ca laddhā vasanañ'ca kāle, mattaṃ so jaññā idha tosan'atthaṃ, so tesu gutto yatacāri gāme, rusito'pi vācaṃ pharusaṃ na vajjā.

25097.commentary: (VINa) gutt'atthāyā'ti yaṃ tattha mañcapīṭh'ādi, tassa gutt'atthāya, taṃ aññatra harituṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

25098.meaning1: guarding the doors (of); with self-restraint (in); protecting the mind (wrt)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti, indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū hoti, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma, cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī n'ānubyañjanaggāhī

25099.commentary: (NIDD1a) indriyesu guttadvāratāyā'ti cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttesu manacchaṭṭhesu indriyesu sugopitadvārabhāvassa.

examples.text: na kamm'ārāmatā, na bhass'ārāmatā, na nidd'ārāmatā, na saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, asaṃsagg'ārāmatā, nippapañc'ārāmatā.
